title: Data And Accounts: Logins & Keys

freshness.note: options reused from security-ready-3 (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Two Security Keys On Your Apple ID: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add a passkey and two Apple Security Keys, then save the recovery key offline. Who does it: You.

Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Apple ID also covers Apple Card.

pairs.ask: Use Cloudflare Logs For Who Unlocked: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Use Cloudflare Access logs (email, time, country) and drop the in-page unlock log. Who does it: UpKeep.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Mapping emails to u-codes for the current unlock log would need a private mapping file.

pairs.ask: Authenticator Or Hardware Key On A Brokerage: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on an authenticator app or a hardware key, then save recovery codes offline. Who does it: You.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: a brokerage account holds real money and is a common takeover target.

Why it matters: a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">brokerage account holds real money and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">is a common takeover target.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: App Approval Instead Of SMS At PNC And SNB: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Switch both banks to an authenticator or app approval and avoid SMS. Who does it: You.

Who</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: SMS codes can be stolen with a SIM swap.

optionA.desc: Use a hardware key or authenticator app, then add the Master Key and Global Settings Lock. Who does it: You.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: a crypto account is a top target for takeover.

pairs.ask: First Agent Tokens: Security And UpKeep: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Give the first per-agent tokens to Security and UpKeep, since they push most often, then roll out to the rest. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Give the first per-agent tokens to</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security and UpKeep, since they push</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">most often, then roll out to the rest.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Starting where pushes happen most gives the biggest drop in risk for the least setup.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Starting where pushes happen most</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">gives the biggest drop in risk for the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">least setup.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Reminder Two Weeks Before Each Agent Token Expires: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Security adds every agent token's expiry date to the Morning Report and warns two weeks ahead. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security adds every agent token's</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">expiry date to the Morning Report and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">warns two weeks ahead. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: 90-day tokens expire on their own. Without a reminder, an agent's pushes would suddenly fail.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">90-day tokens expire on their own.</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Without a reminder, an agent's pushes</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">would suddenly fail.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Offline List Of Key Accounts On Your Phone: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Keep a short offline list on your phone of key accounts, their recovery emails and support numbers, with no passwords. Who does it: You, With Security.

Who does it: You, With</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now

pairs.ask: Move The Box's Saved Page Password Into 1Password Later: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Once 1Password works for agents, move the page password from the private file on the shared computer into the Agents vault. Who does it: Security.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Today the lock tools read it from a private file on the shared computer. A vault is easier to rotate.
